0.reason: PostParse applies env/file sources by calling f.Set on the FlagBase. That path never calls Command.setMultiValueParsingConfig, which only runs in Command.set and Command.Set. The slice and map values therefore keep their zero-value separators when values come from env or file sources. flagSplitMultiValues then falls back to the default separator, so a custom SliceFlagSeparator, a custom MapFlagKeyValueSeparator or DisableSliceFlagSeparator is ignored for those sources.
